IRS990.ActivityOrMissionDesc: We provide children and adults with special needs the opportunity to play baseball in an organized league at two locations in San Diego County.
IRS990.MissionDesc: The Miracle League of San Diego provides children and adults with special needs the opportunity to play baseball in an organized league and strives to be recognized throughout San Diego County as a high-quality safe and inclusive experience for our targeted clientele in order to significantly develop their physical social and mental abilities.
IRS990.Desc: Our noncompetitive division remained at participation levels consistent with the prior year. During the fall season we had 350 players 300 buddies 70 coaches and another 200+ volunteers. Our competitive division expanded with the participation of two players who had played at our second location. In total during our two seasons volunteers contributed well over 20,000 hours. Based on the average dollar total value of a volunteer hour of $38.64 as calculated by the Independent Sector 2024 California Value the total value of volunteer contribution was in excess of $770,000.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: Prior to the first board meeting of the year each board member is provided a copy of the conflict of interest policy and is asked to affirm in writing that he she has read the policy understands the policy is in compliance with the policy and will promptly notify the board of any conflicts as they arise.

The board delegated a committee to conduct a survey of other local similarly-sized nonprofits and to ensure that the proposed compensation was commensurate with the job requirements the executive directors experience and was within an acceptable range relative to the survey.
